content: Podman Quadlet .pod/.container unit syntax: .pod files use [Pod] section with PodName/PublishPort; .container files join via Pod=name.pod key, use AddDevice=/dev/kfd and AddDevice=/dev/dri for GPU passthrough, User=0/Group=0 combine into --user 0:0, Volume=name:/path for named volumes. Rootful units go in /etc/containers/systemd/, rootless in ~/.config/containers/systemd/. No built-in health-gated startup between containers beyond After=/Requires= ordering.
